# Facebook web login checkpoint loop — 2026-09-20/21

**Symptom:** Facebook web login failed on every desktop Chrome (tony-omen + tony-dell, normal AND incognito). Each attempt redirected to `facebook.com/two_step_verification/authentication/?flow=pre_authentication` plus an Arkose/reCAPTCHA iframe on `fbsbx.com`, then bounced back to the logged-out homepage — no `c_user`/`xs` session cookies were ever issued. Mobile app stayed logged in the whole time. Nothing appeared in the app's login alerts or "Where you're logged in" (pre-auth checkpoints never reach the session stage).

**Root cause:** Facebook's server-side risk engine flagged web logins for the account — NOT a Chrome, cookie, extension, DNS, or IP problem. Verified: clean-profile Chrome loaded the login page fine; cookies/clear-on-exit settings normal; UA-switcher extension disabled; residential True Online IP unremarkable.

**Resolution:** Cleared on its own ~24h later (Facebook-side flag expired / changed). Confirmed working 2026-09-21.

**Playbook for next time:**
- Stop retrying — every failed captcha attempt deepens the flag.
- On the logged-in mobile app: Settings → Accounts Centre → Password and security → Two-factor authentication → check the configured method, generate recovery codes; check the in-app notification bell for "approve this login".
- Tether desktop to phone hotspot once — if cellular IP logs straight in, the home IP was flagged.
- `m.facebook.com` / `mbasic.facebook.com` sometimes pass under lighter checkpoint thresholds.
- Last resort: `facebook.com/recover` password reset — resets checkpoint state, but only attempt once.
- Diagnostic shortcut that worked here: Chrome History SQLite (`Default/History`) shows the `two_step_verification` + `fbsbx.com/captcha` redirect chain; cookie jar missing `c_user`/`xs` proves the session never established.

Facebook desktop login issues between Sept 20-21 were caused by a server-side risk flag resulting in a captcha loop; mobile app worked fine, and the issue resolved in 24 hours. Playbook for next time: check mobile app and test tethering to phone hotspot to check for IP issues.

docs.contentMd: The michael-ha weather station is a Rika RK600-07B with an RK900 module, a Samkoon Android HMI at 192.168.31.148. From about Sept 16 the HMI lost its default route (gateway 192.168.31.1), so all cloud uploads failed with network-unreachable while local Modbus kept working. On Sept 22 the route was restored and uploads resumed at about one row per minute to the Rika cloud at 39.99.253.232:8899; a watchdog (rika-cloud-watchdog.py, systemd user unit rika-watchdog.service) on tony-omen keeps the route and Samkoon app alive — zero misses logged since install. The rain sensor (element e5) was verified working overnight Sept 22-23 — real rain events recorded on the dashboard; upload registers 4-15 populate when data exists. Verified Sept 23 by Devin: the working dashboard is the LEGACY platform http://39.99.253.232:8000 (/agriculture/chart; REST API on :8005 — POST /login returns a token, GET /user/R22100502 lists device facId 22100502, GET /datas/22100502?pageNum=1 returns rows newest-first with dataTime in UTC+8; elements e1=wind dir, e2=wind speed, e3=temp x0.1C, e4=humidity x0.1%, e5=rain). The modern portal cloud.rikacloud.com does NOT recognise account R22100502. Latest cloud row seen 2026-09-23 16:10 UTC+8 (15:10 Bangkok), ~1 row/min live, values tracking michael-ha sensors. Account R22100502's password is stored in the Chrome Default profile Login Data on tony-dell — never expose it. Full runbook: docs/kb/rika-rk600-cloud-upload.md in the chaba repo (written Sept 23 on the dispatch branch).
